reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the rendered output leaves both cited paragraphs unchanged with no comment, which is exactly what is expected for a compliant finding — no over-flagging or invalid edit.

Cited text supports the conclusion: p0094 imposes a parity-style obligation on the Licensor (making Revisions available to us when generally released to other licensees), a benefit running to Customer, which the detection guidance expressly says to mark compliant and not redline.

No provision requires Licensee to extend Licensor terms no less favourable than those given to third parties; the finding's treatment of the Article XXII change-of-control right of first refusal as a distinct commercial term (assessed under the ROFR/change-of-control rule rather than double-flagged as a pricing MFN) is consistent with the no-double-flag instruction.
Deterministic checks are empty and the rationale correctly places the clause set at the preferred position (no MFN burden on Customer); retained as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
